response: WHITELASHING A CELLAR WALL IS A COMMON WAY TO PREVENT MOLD AND DAMAGE. IT INCLUDS APPLYING A WHITE COATING TO THE WALLS AND FLOOR. THIS PREVENTS WATER FROM DRIING INTO THE MATERIALS. IT IS EASY TO DO AND COST-Effective. USE A WATER BASED SEALANT AND MAKE SURE TO CLEAN THE SURFACE BEFORE APPLYING. THIS HELPS TO PROTECT THE CELLAR FROM RAIN AND FROST. KEEP THE WALLS CLEAN AND DRY FOR A LONGER LIFE.
